public.text: The statement that the same element appears consistently across views assumes stable identifiers and controlled reuse. The document does not specify how element identity is maintained across diagrams, exports, versions, or country adaptations.
public.suggestedRevision: Require globally unique and persistent identifiers for architecture elements, with controlled labels, version metadata, status, provenance, and machine-readable mappings across releases and country models.
